counter_scope.tx: KindLINK successfully/failed post Emit and partial EmitBatch only, not health or re-TCP
counter_scope.rx: authenticated first-unique KindLINK; late and duplicate counted within bounded record PN window, no health
counter_scope.hot_path: existing TX/RX mutex, O(1) no alloc per record; snapshot O(256) each 2s
counter_scope.local_drop: failed local first Emit not WAN
counter_scope.age: since most recent successfully emitted DATA within PN span; UNKNOWN 0xffff
counter_scope.capacity: late beyond PN span marks LIMITED
counter_scope.flags: WINDOW_VALID|INSUFFICIENT if sender DATA exists; otherwise INSUFFICIENT; never LOSS_ESTIMATED
